decision_rule: Rank exact official Town Hall WALLSURFACEs by deterministic same-scene shaded white-stone A/B. Exclude shipped/rejected/unregistered faces. A nominee must pass both impact thresholds, bbox size, horizontal edge margin and center-offset limits. The winner is evidence-only and requires separate source registration plus human full-frame review before any implementation.
